02_design.scientific_parameters: Explicit draft choices require review and freezing before execution

settings.preservation: New outputs only in new run. Every existing original model is preserved. No inference for tasks with any historical CIF.
settings.seed_scope: Seed 0 per recovery invocation; original group membership retained except completed models and six pilot tasks. RNG replay of a partially completed native batch is not claimed.

ranking.scope: all four source cohorts separately; full completed human/mouse pairs required
ranking.IPSAE: best binder-protomer symmetric ipSAE (D vs A/B/C); PAE cutoff 10; distance diagnostics cutoff 15
ranking.species_aggregation: arithmetic mean of human and mouse
